name: Shadow Step / Shadow Step A / Shadow Step R

values.meaning: Heal upon first entering terrain from casting Shadow Step

mechanics.claim: Kayn heals himself upon entering terrain for the first time from casting Shadow Step.
mechanics.quote: Kayn heals himself upon entering terrain for the first time from casting ''Shadow Step''

mechanics.claim: Receiving damage from or dealing damage to an enemy champion while Shadow Step is active cuts its remaining duration to 1.5 seconds, and it cancels immediately on a basic attack, immobilize, or polymorph.
mechanics.quote: Receiving damage from or dealing damage to an enemy {{tip|champion}} while ''Shadow Step'' is active reduces its remaining duration to {{fd|1.5}} seconds ... will cancel immediately if '''Kayn''' performs a [[basic attack]] or becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphed}}

mechanics.claim: As Shadow Assassin, Shadow Step's cooldown is reduced to a flat 10 seconds at all ranks, overriding the base cooldown-by-rank values.
mechanics.quote: ''Shadow Step's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced to 10 seconds at all ranks

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts after the effect ends (post-effect), not on cast.
